_note: Starting rules for ootk, none confirmed with Ted yet, so violations report as warn ('unconfirmed rule') and never fail. Set confirmed:true per rule once agreed. Globs: ** any depth, * within one segment, paths repo-relative. 'to' is matched against the resolved import path (alias-expanded) or the raw specifier for packages.

rules.description: Library source never imports tests or scripts.
Shipped source never imports dev-only packages (they are not in dependencies).
Low-level modules (sgp4, time, utils, enums, types, interfaces) do not import high-level domain modules (operations, scheduling, conjunction, maneuver, breakup, constellation, orbit-design).
